about: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B heretic (refusals removed) IQ4_XS with its MTP head on one 12 GB RDNA2 card (gfx1031: RX 6700 XT / 6750 XT), experts in system RAM: 24 of 40 expert layers stay in pinned host RAM (--n-cpu-moe 24, --load-mode none); the 131,072-token q8_0 KV (only 10 of 40 layers hold KV), attention, shared weights and the rest of the experts on the GPU. Drafts come from the MTP head and from n-grams of the context (ngram-mod, up to 256 tokens); the draft context costs about 1 GiB of VRAM, which forces -ub 1024. Thinking is capped at 2048 tokens: uncapped, the model occasionally reasons in circles until it runs out of tokens. ROCm gfx1030 code objects via HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION. The configuration a daily-driver server ran for SWE-bench Verified Mini (27/50 with mini-swe-agent). Measured on one RX 6700 XT (PCIe 4.0 x16), Ryzen 5 5600X, 32 GB DDR4-2933 single channel: 12,098 of 12,272 MiB VRAM at the peak of the 106K-token context gate and at most a 14.7 GB MemAvailable drop over three gate runs; host_ram_gb adds headroom for the host prompt cache (--cache-ram 6144), which grows with use. Overfilling VRAM on RDNA2 can deadlock amdgpu instead of failing, so do not lower --n-cpu-moe on a 12 GB card.
